items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Interviewee states Jimmy Johnson 'used to play with Bolden' and confirms 'Buddy Bolden's band' existed, but does not claim to have played with or met Bolden himself.

ctx.x: Do you remember, was Jimmy Johnson older than you? I guess he was.

Oh, yeah. Jimmy, Jimmy, Jimmy Johnson, yeah, I used to sing. Oh, sure, we all met him. Sure. Of course. Jimmy Johnson, well, he played all right. He used to play with Jack Carey, you know. He played with the Crescent Band, you know. I love the Crescent Band. Yeah, and before he played with the Crescent Band, he used to play with, um. Play with Bolden. Buddy Bolden. Buddy Bolden.
Did you ever hear Bolden's band, that's one year?

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: That's where they built the cage. ... Where Al-Twenty's old place was.

ctx.x: I started Bill Johnson. So you stayed out here then? Yeah. And who'd you work with then?

Over there, because that's where I was going. Nowhere was here, I was always over there. Over there in Oakland. He went to work. He went to work. And he goes to work at where this place was at 35th and Calumet. Oh yeah. Where Al-Twenty's old place was. That's where they built the cage. The cage? The cage? What is it? Yeah, I forgot the name. A big place there.
